EmailTemplate.subject: Don’t wait for patients to self-serve. Bring Self-Service to them.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Not all payment portals are created equal. Most online bill pay offerings take a passive approach to patient outreach. You build it, and you hope they come. But simply having an online payment portal doesn’t mean patients will. And even if they get there, it doesn’t guarantee they’ll stay.
So how do you increase self-service rates while ensuring patient payments don’t slip through your fingers?
To maximize self-service, Flywire creates personalized outreach to patients using the latest AI & machine learning technologies. With Flywire, you can automate your previously manual engagement and meet patients where and when they prefer with the right messages to ensure they'll take action. Using Flywire, our client Kettering Health Network <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/case-study-kettering-health-network?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> saw an 87% increase in self-service payments.
Learn more <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/healthcare?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> about how you can increase your self-service payments today using Flywire.
